resources.string: Plain text is inserted literally. For a sequence, start with #!keys, then one action per line: text …, ctrl+c, enter, tab, escape, or wait 500 (milliseconds).
Key sequences run their actions in order after confirmation.
Invalid key sequence. Use text …, ctrl+a through ctrl+z, enter, tab, escape, or wait 1–10000. Total waits must not exceed 60000 ms.
